findings.issue: INVEST Testable still says 'eight criteria', but section 7 now has AC1 to AC13.
Section 2 says only the AC6 title changed, but decision log wording was replaced in several legacy criteria.
Lint: AC12 is used by two scenarios in section 7.
AC12 404 reads a single agent run, an operation the story does not name. The link operation is the one that takes a runId.
AC12 does not mark the 401 and 404 message IDs as not specified, and the section 12 error list omits 404.
AC13 has the agent client refuse a case status change, but the story never reads or owns case status. The agent run is its own record.
A 'Not specified' size placeholder does not resolve the Size failure. Sizing is left to squad refinement.
